baseline_versions.note: Versions declared by the pinned aports tree for the v3.23 branch. Alpine's release repositories keep moving, so this is the version the pinned source tree declares, not proof of what a given build installed. The versions a build actually shipped are recorded per ISO in <iso>.build-manifest.json by distro/alpine/mkimage.sh. meets_baseline flags below are version comparisons against these values, not probes.
